model_annotation: The image displays a set of three pie charts representing different logical or linguistic classifications, titled "Categorical," "Approximate Number Generation," and "Disjunctive &Conjunctive." Across all three charts, there is no separate legend; instead, bolded text labels and exact percentages are positioned directly inside each slice, and no segments are visually exploded or offset. The first chart, "Categorical," consists of four slices: a light grey-blue slice for "Universal Quantifiers" (29.07%), a light pink slice for "Limiter" (27.91%), a light orange slice for "Negation" (27.91%), and a light green slice for "Existential Quantifiers" (15.12%). The second chart, "Approximate Number Generation," contains three slices arranged in descending order of size clockwise: a light beige slice labeled "Approximate Quantities" (45.03%), a light blue slice for "Comparative Relationships" (36.26%), and a light purple slice for "Absolute Absence" (18.71%). The third chart, "Disjunctive &Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal slices: a light pinkish-purple segment for "Conjunctive" (50.49%) and a very light blue-grey segment for "Disjunctive" (49.51%).
